type_contract.envelope: Imported canonical RecordEnvelope; fields below extend payload, state is in the envelope only. No null unless explicitly allowed.
type_contract.references: Exact canonical Ref; aliases never become independent Ref.record_type. StageRef is a distinct local-staging type, not Ref.

scalars.UTC: Canonical RFC3339 UTC string with Z
scalars.UInt64: Canonical decimal integer string per kernel
scalars.Money: Canonical currency/signed minor_units/exponent tuple from kernel
scalars.Position: Kernel generation/sequence/transaction_hash; only already established source Positions in new bodies
scalars.StageRef: Kernel local_staged reference; never accepted authority
